description: This file defines the class `tlPlatform`, which handles platform-related operations within the TestLink project. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving platform data, as well as managing associations with test plans and enabling/disabling platform features.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: A class for handling platforms within TestLink, extending tlObjectWithDB, providing CRUD operations, associations, and visibility controls for platform data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing database connection and setting test project context.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new platform in the database.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Retrieves platform data by ID.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves platform data by name.

methods.name: getPlatform
methods.description: Returns all info of a platform by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates platform data in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a platform by ID.

methods.name: linkToTestplan
methods.description: Links one or more platforms to a test plan.

methods.name: unlinkFromTestplan
methods.description: Removes link(s) between platform(s) and a test plan.

methods.name: getID
methods.description: Retrieves platform ID by name.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all platforms for the current test project, with optional linked count.

methods.name: getAllAsMap
methods.description: Returns all platforms as a map (ID to name), with filtering options.

methods.name: platformsActiveForTestplan
methods.description: Checks if a test plan has linked platforms.

methods.name: getLinkedToTestplan
methods.description: Returns platforms linked to a specific test plan in various formats.

methods.name: getLinkedToTestplanAsMap
methods.description: Returns linked platforms as a map of IDs to names, with filtering options.

methods.name: throwIfEmptyName
methods.description: Validates that the platform name is not empty.

methods.name: deleteByTestProject
methods.description: Deletes all platforms associated with a specific test project.

methods.name: testProjectCount
methods.description: Counts platforms grouped by test project.

methods.name: belongsToTestProject
methods.description: Checks if a platform belongs to a specific test project.

methods.name: isLinkedToTestplan
methods.description: Checks if a platform is linked to a specific test plan.

methods.name: initViewGUI
methods.description: Initializes the GUI view for platforms in the web interface.

methods.name: enableDesign
methods.description: Enables platform for design phase.

methods.name: disableDesign
methods.description: Disables platform for design phase.

methods.name: enableExec
methods.description: Enables platform for execution phase.

methods.name: disableExec
methods.description: Disables platform for execution phase.

methods.name: openForExec
methods.description: Makes platform open for execution.

methods.name: closeForExec
methods.description: Closes platform for execution.

methods.name: getAsXMLString
methods.description: Generates an XML string listing platforms for a test project.
